mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 level above its 5-year average signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth below 0.5% and INDPRO growth below 0.3% signals weakening labor market and industrial output, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment to produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO growth rates are below thresholds, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
